summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and parametrized tests. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (38 passed). Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort were not available in the shared venv, so type checking and formatting are unchecked. The non-Node guard in the parser may be flagged as unreachable by mypy with warn_unreachable enabled.
